title: Bhavaprakasha Nighantu
author: Traditional attribution (Bhavamishra)
provenance: Adapted from classical Nighantu sections on herb properties, formulations, and pharmacology.
description: Important Ayurvedic pharmacopeia classifying herbs by therapeutic groups. Covers immunomodulatory herbs (Guduchyadi Varga), digestive herbs (Haritakyadi Varga), anti-inflammatory herbs (Haridradi Varga), and neurological herbs (Vatadi Varga).
